rows.label: COFFEE GROUNDS
rows.clue: The dregs remaining after brewing coffee

rows.label: TIDELAND
rows.clue: Land near the sea that is overflowed by the tide

rows.label: BUTTE
rows.clue: A hill that rises abruptly from the surrounding region

rows.label: ICE FIELD
rows.clue: A large flat mass of ice (larger than an ice floe) floating at sea

rows.label: ICE CAP
rows.clue: A mass of ice and snow that permanently covers a large area of land (e.g., the polar regions or a mountain peak)

rows.label: LAKE BED
rows.clue: The bottom of a lake

rows.label: WIND GAP
rows.clue: A pass in a mountain ridge with no stream flowing through it

rows.label: METAL FILING
rows.clue: A fragment of metal rubbed off by the use of a file

rows.label: SLIVER
rows.clue: A small thin sharp bit or wood or glass or metal

rows.label: SOAP BUBBLE
rows.clue: A bubble formed by a thin soap film

rows.label: GORGE
rows.clue: A deep ravine (usually with a river running through it)

rows.label: ESTUARY
rows.clue: The wide part of a river where it nears the sea

rows.label: OZONE HOLE
rows.clue: An area of the ozone layer (near the poles) that is seasonally depleted of ozone

rows.label: TREE FARM
rows.clue: A forest (or part of a forest) where trees are grown for commercial use

rows.label: MEANDER
rows.clue: A bend or curve, as in a stream or river

rows.label: TANGLE
rows.clue: A twisted and tangled mass that is highly interwoven

rows.label: BLACK HOLE
rows.clue: A region of space resulting from the collapse of a star

rows.label: SCURF
rows.clue: (botany) a covering that resembles scales or bran that covers some plant parts

rows.label: SNOWDRIFT
rows.clue: A mass of snow heaped up by the wind

rows.label: PARING
rows.clue: A thin fragment or slice (especially of wood) that has been shaved from something

rows.label: ASTEROID
rows.clue: Any of numerous small celestial bodies composed of rock and metal that move around the sun (mainly between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter)

rows.label: BURROW
rows.clue: A hole made by an animal, usually for shelter

rows.label: LOWLAND
rows.clue: Low level country

rows.label: HAIR BALL
rows.clue: A compact mass of hair that forms in the alimentary canal (especially in the stomach of animals as a result of licking fur)

rows.label: FATIGUE CRACK
rows.clue: A crack in metal resulting from metal fatigue

rows.label: KIDNEY STONE
rows.clue: A calculus formed in the kidney

rows.label: TROPOSPHERE
rows.clue: The lowest atmospheric layer

rows.label: WATERCOURSE
rows.clue: Natural or artificial channel through which water flows

rows.label: MULTIPLE STAR
rows.clue: A system of three or more stars associated by gravity

rows.label: TILLED LAND
rows.clue: Arable land that is worked by plowing and sowing and raising crops

rows.label: CUMULUS
rows.clue: A globular cloud

rows.label: ANTIPARTICLE
rows.clue: A particle that has the same mass as another particle but has opposite values for its other properties

rows.label: STREAM
rows.clue: A natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth

rows.label: LOWER MANTLE
rows.clue: The deeper part of the mantle

rows.label: RIPPLE MARK
rows.clue: One of a series of small ridges produced in sand by water currents or by wind

rows.label: FIXED STAR
rows.clue: Any star in the Ptolemaic theory of planetary motion

rows.label: DESIDERATUM
rows.clue: Something desired as a necessity

rows.label: STONE
rows.clue: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter

rows.label: COVERING
rows.clue: A natural object that covers or envelops

rows.label: METEOR SWARM
rows.clue: A group of meteoroids with similar paths

rows.label: SHEET
rows.clue: Any broad thin expanse or surface

rows.label: RIDGE
rows.clue: A long narrow natural elevation or striation

rows.label: BLADDER STONE
rows.clue: A calculus formed in the bladder

rows.label: GULCH
rows.clue: A narrow gorge with a stream running through it

rows.label: HEADLAND
rows.clue: A natural elevation (especially a rocky one that juts out into the sea)

rows.label: FOOTHILL
rows.clue: A relatively low hill on the lower slope of a mountain

rows.label: CASCADE
rows.clue: A small waterfall or series of small waterfalls

rows.label: AIR BUBBLE
rows.clue: A bubble of air

rows.label: METEORITE
rows.clue: Stony or metallic object that is the remains of a meteoroid that has reached the earth's surface

rows.label: QUASAR
rows.clue: A starlike object that may send out radio waves and other forms of energy

rows.label: STEPPING STONE
rows.clue: A stone in a marsh or shallow water that can be stepped on in crossing

rows.label: WATERSIDE
rows.clue: Land bordering a body of water

rows.label: BAYOU
rows.clue: A swampy arm or slow-moving outlet of a lake (term used mainly in Mississippi and Louisiana)

rows.label: WOODLAND
rows.clue: Land that is covered with trees and shrubs

rows.label: BIRD NEST
rows.clue: Nest where birds lay their eggs and hatch their young

rows.label: OVERBURDEN
rows.clue: The surface soil that must be moved away to get at coal seams and mineral deposits

rows.label: PENINSULA
rows.clue: A large mass of land projecting into a body of water

rows.label: GUIDE FOSSIL
rows.clue: A fossil known to have lived in a particular geologic age that can be used to date the rock layer in which it is found

rows.label: MOORLAND
rows.clue: Open land usually with peaty soil covered with heather and bracken and moss

rows.label: ELIMINATOR
rows.clue: An agent that eliminates something

rows.label: INLET
rows.clue: An arm off of a larger body of water (often between rocky headlands)

rows.label: REVERSE FAULT
rows.clue: A geological fault in which the upper side appears to have been pushed upward by compression

rows.label: ARROYO
rows.clue: A stream or brook

rows.label: WATERWAY
rows.clue: A navigable body of water

rows.label: MOLEHILL
rows.clue: A mound of earth made by moles while burrowing

rows.label: WEAKENER
rows.clue: That which weakens or causes a loss of strength

rows.label: HONEYCOMB
rows.clue: A structure of small hexagonal cells constructed from beeswax by bees and used to store honey and larvae

rows.label: HEAVENLY BODY
rows.clue: Natural objects visible in the sky

rows.label: ORE BED
rows.clue: A stratum of ore

rows.label: WORMHOLE
rows.clue: Hole made by a burrowing worm

rows.label: BONANZA
rows.clue: An especially rich vein of precious ore

rows.label: MORAINE
rows.clue: Accumulated earth and stones deposited by a glacier

rows.label: PLATEAU
rows.clue: A relatively flat highland

rows.label: MINERAL VEIN
rows.clue: A layer of ore between layers of rock

rows.label: GLUON
rows.clue: A gauge boson that mediates strong interaction among quarks

rows.label: OUTER PLANET
rows.clue: (astronomy) a major planet whose orbit is outside the asteroid belt (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto)

rows.label: COMMEMORATIVE
rows.clue: An object (such as a coin or postage stamp) made to mark an event or honor a person

rows.label: BLUFF
rows.clue: A high steep bank (usually formed by river erosion)

rows.label: CLIMB
rows.clue: An upward slope or grade (as in a road)

rows.label: MESOSPHERE
rows.clue: The atmospheric layer between the stratosphere and the thermosphere

rows.label: EXOSPHERE
rows.clue: The outermost atmospheric layer

rows.label: MOUNTAIN
rows.clue: A land mass that projects well above its surroundings

rows.label: MORNING STAR
rows.clue: A planet (usually Venus) seen just before sunrise in the eastern sky

rows.label: NATURAL ORDER
rows.clue: The physical universe considered as an orderly system subject to natural (not human or supernatural) laws

rows.label: PACK ICE
rows.clue: A large expanse of floating ice

rows.label: INCLINED FAULT
rows.clue: A geological fault in which one side is above the other

rows.label: HOT SPRING
rows.clue: A natural spring of water at a temperature of 70 F or above

rows.label: OUTCROP
rows.clue: The part of a rock formation that appears above the surface of the surrounding land

rows.label: AQUIFER
rows.clue: Underground bed or layer yielding ground water for wells and springs etc

rows.label: WALL ROCK
rows.clue: A rock immediately adjacent to a vein or fault

rows.label: AGENT
rows.clue: An active and efficient cause

rows.label: FIRE PIT
rows.clue: A pit whose floor is incandescent lava

rows.label: GRAIN
rows.clue: A relatively small granular particle of a substance

rows.label: NUCLEON
rows.clue: A constituent (proton or neutron) of an atomic nucleus

rows.label: ICE SHELF
rows.clue: Ice that is attached to land but projects out to sea

rows.label: DRUMLIN
rows.clue: A mound of glacial drift
